Fact: required_hardware
What to find: Hardware required to run the model (e.g. GPU memory, number of accelerators).
Card sections that often contain it: Hardware, Requirements, Deployment

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Models with up to 30B parameters can be deployed on a single A100 GPU (the 38B model needs two A100 GPUs, the 235B model eight A100 GPUs). This 20B-A4B model is within the up-to-30B range. The card also recommends vLLM for InternVL3.5-20B-A4B since lmdeploy does not yet support GPT-OSS.
quotes: Please note that our models with up to 30B parameters can be deployed on a single A100 GPU, while the 38B model requires two A100 GPUs and the 235B model requires eight A100 GPUs.
